decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed development, due to its size, position and appearance, would result in an unduly dominant and obtrusive development, which would be out of scale and character with the streetscene, and detrimental to the visual and residential amenities of the area, resulting in enclosure, loss of light and outlook to neighbouring residential properties, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1, E.1.5 and H.1.1 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (Adopted December 2003).

Condition : 2 - 2/The proposed development would fail to provide sufficient amenity space, detrimental to the residential amenity of the future occupiers of this family sized accommodation, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.4.1 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (Adopted December 2003) and associated Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 3 - 3/The proposed off-street parking and servicing provision, due to the insufficient number of bays, substandard layout and absence of arrangements for the storage and collection of waste and recycling, would fail to meet the Council's parking and servicing standards, and would result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to UDP policy T.1.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (Adopted December 2003).
description: Demolition of existing building and erection of two/three storey building comprising 5 x two bed flats.
